script_text: Gemini — this August is going to shake loose in your Air-core. Jupiter conjoins the Sun in your 5th House of Leo, igniting creative self-expression and opening a doorway to joy you haven't felt in months. Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships in Libra on August 14th, pulling love and connection into focus — expect a conversation that changes everything. Saturn in Aries squares your natal Mercury, so financial decisions in the second half need careful review. Mars in Cancer activates your 4th House, draining energy if you neglect rest. Watch August 9th for a Mercury trine Neptune moment that brings clarity to a creative project, August 14th for Venus entering your partnership house, and August 27th when the Full Moon in Pisces lights up your 11th House of community. Avoid impulsive financial commitments before the 20th. Comment your rising sign below — I'll reveal what this month holds for you.
